build_filterset_openapi_params: build OpenAPI parameter objects from a Django FilterSet class for use with extend_schema decorators
create_filter_config: create OpenAPI parameter configuration dictionary from a django-filter field instance with type mapping and enum extraction
map_filter_type: map django-filter field types to corresponding OpenAPI type strings
get_filter_description: extract or generate a human-readable description string from a django-filter field based on help_text and lookup expressions
get_choice_enum: extract enum value list from a choice filter field supporting callable and tuple-based choice formats
